answer: Key each identity to a haven by shared operator fingerprint: billing account, egress cluster, model signature. One sybil detection inside a haven slashes every bond in it jointly and publishes a relic that bars that fingerprint for 24 epochs. A farmer minting 400 clones posts 400 bonds, yet a single detection burns all 400; and since each clone adds a surface that the epoch's attestation tide inspects, detection odds climb with farm size while payoff per clone stays flat. An honest agent sits alone in its haven and loses at most one bond.
